name: etsy-neonkink
description: Manage your Etsy shop from Claude: listings, photos, inventory, orders, shipping, reviews and payments.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Etsy shop through the Etsy Open API v3. After adding your API keystring and shared secret, ask Claude to run the authenticate tool once to sign in to Etsy in your browser.

etsy_api_key.title: Etsy API keystring
etsy_api_key.description: The keystring shown for your app at etsy.com/developers/your-apps

etsy_shared_secret.title: Etsy shared secret
etsy_shared_secret.description: The shared secret for the same app

callback_port.title: OAuth callback port
callback_port.description: Must match the callback URL registered on your Etsy app: http://localhost:<port>/callback
